title: code_index.repo_map request
description: Compute a personalized PageRank over the typed symbol graph and render a compact structural repo map.

task.description: Current user task text. Identifier-like terms boost matching symbols.

context_files.description: Workspace-relative or absolute files already in context. Symbols in these files receive a stronger personalization boost.

max_entries.description: Maximum ranked definition entries to return before token-budget rendering.

token_budget.description: Approximate token budget for the rendered map. The renderer caps output at 4 * token_budget characters.
